ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: nerves steadied by danger held
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}: the fights {PAWN_pronoun} came through have steadied {PAWN_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After the fights {PAWN_pronoun} has stood through, it takes more than a raid to shake {PAWN_objective} now.

plain.li: The alarm went today and my hands stayed still. I noticed that before I noticed the alarm.
Someone asked me how I keep so calm when they come. I don't know. It used to be different.
I slept through the night after the last fight. A year ago I'd have been up till dawn.

warm.li: I've stood next to these people enough times now that I trust the ground under me. That's what it is.

blunt.li: Fights don't rattle me anymore. Good.

cheerful.li: I caught myself whistling while I cleaned my weapon after the raid. Who is this person?

gloomy.li: I'm calm in a fight now. I suppose that's what happens when you've seen enough of them.

cold.li: Fear is less useful than I thought. I seem to have stopped spending it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: iron will after many fights
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} was steady before; after holding the line again and again, very little reaches {PAWN_objective} at all.

plain.li: They hit the wall hard tonight. I counted shots and waited. It was almost peaceful.
The others look at me before they look at the raiders now. I keep my face still for them.

warm.li: When it gets loud, the young ones stand close to me. I won't move while they're there.

cheerful.li: Raid this morning, stew this evening. Both handled.

gloomy.li: Nothing frightens me now. I'm not sure that's the gift people think it is.

cold.li: I have stopped feeling the fear before a fight. I note the change and keep working.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: nerves frayed by fright and captivity

li.any: BrokeUnderFire, Rimfolk_Mark_DownedShaken, Rimfolk_Mark_RaidsWornDown, Imprisoned, Enslaved, Rimfolk_Mark_ShakenByTheUnknown, Rimfolk_Mark_LostKinChild

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}: too many frights have worn the steadiness out of {PAWN_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Too many frights in too short a time: {PAWN_nameDef} startles easily now, and a bad day can tip {PAWN_objective} over.

plain.li: A door banged in the wind and I was on the floor before I knew why.
I don't sleep with my back to the door anymore. I don't sleep much at all.
Everyone else seems to forget the last raid after a few days. I'm still in it.

warm.li: The others are patient with me when I jump at nothing. I wish I could be patient with myself.

blunt.li: My nerves are shot. That's all there is to say.

cheerful.li: I've decided my new hobby is flinching. I'm getting very good at it.

gloomy.li: Every noise is the next attack. One day one of them will be.

cold.li: My reactions have become unreliable. I would not put myself on the wall.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a nervous one pushed past breaking

li.any: BrokeUnderFire, Rimfolk_Mark_DownedShaken, Rimfolk_Mark_RaidsWornDown, Imprisoned, Enslaved, Rimfolk_Mark_ShakenByTheUnknown, LashedOut, Loss

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} was nervous before; after breaking under fire and the losses since, {PAWN_pronoun} is close to the edge most days.

plain.li: I shouted at the cook today over nothing. Over a spoon. I could hear myself and couldn't stop.
Something in me is wound too tight. I can feel it humming when I try to sleep.

warm.li: I keep apologising to people. They keep saying it's all right. It isn't, and they're kind to say it.

blunt.li: Leave me be for a while. I mean it.

cheerful.li: I'm told I'm "a lot" lately. Fair. I'd steer clear of me too.

gloomy.li: I can feel the next breakdown coming the way you feel weather in a bad knee.

cold.li: My temper has become a hazard. The others have started planning around it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a volatile temper softened by calm years

li.any: Married, LongPeace, ForgivenBy, RaisedChild, BecameParent, MovingRitual, NursedBack

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two years without a breakdown, and a reason to stay steady: {PAWN_nameDef} still frays, but no longer snaps.

plain.li: I got angry today and then it passed, like weather. I stood there waiting for the rest of it and it didn't come.
I can't remember the last time I broke something. That used to be every season.

warm.li: I think having people who'd forgive me made it easier not to need forgiving so often.

cheerful.li: Two whole years and not one smashed bowl. Someone should carve me a medal. A small one.

gloomy.li: Calmer, they say. I still feel it. I just don't let it out.

cold.li: My outbursts have stopped. Peace suits my temperament better than I expected.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a darker outlook after heavy losses
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer an {TRAIT}: the graves of the last seasons took it out of {PAWN_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After the graves of the last seasons, {PAWN_pronoun} expects the worst, and it weighs on {PAWN_possessive} mood every day.

plain.li: Planted the beans today and caught myself thinking about who won't be here to eat them.
I used to wake up and wonder what the day would bring. Now I already know.
Walked past the graves on the way to the fields. There's a path worn there now.

warm.li: I love these people, and I've started bracing for losing each of them. I wish I could stop.

blunt.li: Good things end. Bad things come. I've stopped pretending otherwise.

cheerful.li: I tried to tell a joke at supper and halfway through I forgot why it was funny.

gloomy.li: Every year here costs someone. I've started counting.

cold.li: I no longer expect things to improve. It's a more accurate way to live.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a pessimist sunk into despair
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} already expected the worst; after loss on loss {PAWN_pronoun} has sunk under it, and good days barely reach {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: Got up. Ate. Worked. Came back. I keep writing it down so I know the days happened.
They had a party tonight. I could hear it through the wall. I lay there and listened.

warm.li: Someone left flowers on my bed. I sat with them a long time. I couldn't feel anything about them and that frightened me.

cheerful.li: I used to be the one who cheered people up. I remember how. I just can't find the start of it.

gloomy.li: I don't think I'll feel better. I think this is what I am now.

cold.li: The days have stopped meaning anything in particular. I continue them anyway.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a brighter outlook after a good stretch

li.any: LongPeace, Married, BecameParent, RaisedChild, Freed, AddictionOvercome, MovingRitual, NursedBack, Elected, Legendary

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer a {TRAIT}: a good stretch here has lifted {PAWN_objective}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A good stretch of life here has lifted {PAWN_objective}: {PAWN_pronoun} expects tomorrow to be all right, and it shows in {PAWN_possessive} mood.

plain.li: Woke up before the bell and went out to see the sun come up over the fields. No reason. Just wanted to.
I've started making plans for next year. Real ones, with seeds and wood counted.
Things are good. I keep waiting for the catch and it keeps not coming.

warm.li: I look around the table at supper and I'm grateful, every night. I didn't used to be like this.

blunt.li: Life's decent here. I'll say it.

cheerful.li: I hummed all the way through hauling today. Someone threw a turnip at me. Worth it.

gloomy.li: I'm almost hopeful lately. Don't tell anyone.

cold.li: The odds here have improved. I find I enjoy that more than I expected to.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an optimist grown sunny through and through

li.any: LongPeace, Married, BecameParent, RaisedChild, Freed, AddictionOvercome, MovingRitual, NursedBack, Elected, Legendary

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} was hopeful before; a long run of good years has made {PAWN_objective} hard to bring down at all.

plain.li: Rain all day. I went out in it anyway. It was lovely.
I've stopped keeping a list of what could go wrong. I keep one of what went right instead. It's longer.

warm.li: Every face at this table is someone I'm glad of. I tell them so, and they roll their eyes, and I don't mind.

blunt.li: I'm happy. Get used to it.

cheerful.li: Burnt the porridge, laughed until I cried, ate it anyway. Best morning in ages.

gloomy.li: I keep trying to worry like I used to. It won't stick.

cold.li: My mood no longer tracks circumstances closely. A strange and convenient development.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: despair lifting after better days

li.any: LongPeace, Married, BecameParent, RaisedChild, Freed, AddictionOvercome, MovingRitual, NursedBack, Kindness, ForgivenBy

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer depressive, only a {TRAIT}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: The worst of it has lifted: {PAWN_nameDef} still expects little of the world, but good days reach {PAWN_objective} again.

plain.li: I laughed today. Someone dropped a pie and I laughed, and then I had to sit down because I'd forgotten I could.
The grey is thinner lately. I can see shapes through it.

warm.li: They never gave up on me. I don't know how to repay that, but I'd like to be around long enough to try.

cheerful.li: I had a second helping tonight because I wanted it. Small victories.

gloomy.li: It's lighter. I don't trust it yet, but it's lighter.

cold.li: The heaviness has receded somewhat. I will take the improvement without asking where it came from.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: harder working after a long stretch of work done well
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}: a long stretch of work that came out well has changed {PAWN_possessive} habits.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two seasons of barely stopping, and work {PAWN_pronoun} is proud of to show for it: {PAWN_pronoun} works faster now, and likes it.

plain.li: Finished early and started the next job before anyone could hand me one.
I sat down for a break today and got up again after a minute. My hands wanted something to do.
There's a rhythm to a long day now. I fall into it before breakfast.

warm.li: I like knowing the others can lean on me to get things done. It's a good feeling, being that person.

blunt.li: Work's there. I do it. Simple.

cheerful.li: I've started racing the sun to the end of each job. The sun's winning, but it's close.

gloomy.li: If I stop working I start thinking. So I don't stop.

cold.li: My output has improved considerably. Idle time no longer interests me.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: idler after long idle stretches
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} is no longer {TRAIT}: two seasons with more leisure than work have slowed {PAWN_objective} down.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two seasons with more leisure than work have slowed {PAWN_objective} down: {PAWN_nameDef} works more slowly now.

plain.li: Played horseshoes most of the afternoon. Nobody asked me to do anything, so I didn't.
Started on the stockpile and then the sun was so nice. Tomorrow, then.
I've got very good at looking busy. It takes less effort than being busy.

warm.li: There's no rush here anymore. I like that about us. Maybe I like it a bit too much.

blunt.li: Why hurry? It'll still be there.

cheerful.li: Took a nap in the hay today. Then a nap after the nap. Excellent day.

gloomy.li: It's hard to care about the work when it never ends anyway.

cold.li: Effort has diminishing returns. I've adjusted mine accordingly.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: an addiction overcome, and a turn away from drugs
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.newsLost: {PAWN_nameDef} no longer has a {TRAIT}: getting free of an addiction cured {PAWN_objective} of it.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Having fought free of an addiction, {PAWN_nameDef} wants nothing more to do with drugs, and minds seeing others take them.

plain.li: Someone offered me a drink at the party. I said no and it was easy. It didn't used to be.
I poured the last of my stash into the river. Watched it go.
I remember the shakes. I'm not going back there. Not for anything.

warm.li: I owe the people who sat with me through the worst of it. The least I can do is stay clean.

blunt.li: No more. Not a sip, not a puff. Done.

cheerful.li: Clear head, steady hands, and I remember every evening now. Highly recommended.

gloomy.li: I still think about it sometimes. That's why I don't keep any near me.

cold.li: The chemical dependency was a weakness. I've removed it, and I intend to keep it removed.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a chemical fascination eased by an addiction overcome
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.news: {PAWN_nameDef}'s chemical fascination has eased to a {TRAIT}.
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Fighting free of an addiction has cooled {PAWN_possessive} hunger for drugs: {PAWN_pronoun} still likes them, but no longer needs them close.

plain.li: I walked past the drug shelf today without stopping. Then I went back and looked, but I didn't take anything.
I used to plan my day around the next dose. Now I plan it around work and supper, like everyone else.

warm.li: The others kept me busy through the worst weeks. I think they knew exactly what they were doing.

blunt.li: I can take it or leave it now. Mostly leave it.

cheerful.li: I had one smoke at the party and then just danced. I remember the whole night. Novel.

gloomy.li: The want is quieter. It hasn't gone anywhere. I just hear it less.

cold.li: My cravings are manageable now. I find the control satisfying.
